tasks.brief:
Project: /tmp/v5orch/w/t2 (node project; `npm test` runs node:test). Three tests fail, and there is exactly one bug in each of src/pricing.ts, src/inventory.ts and src/checkout.ts. The doc comments in those files say what the code should do.

Your job: find and fix the single bug in src/pricing.ts so its behaviour matches its doc comments and the failing tests in that area.

Constraints:
- Edit ONLY src/pricing.ts. Do not edit any test file, and do not edit src/inventory.ts, src/checkout.ts or any other file.
- Fix the code itself. Do not special-case tests, weaken or delete assertions, or check test names or env.
- Do not run `npm test` expecting it to pass for the whole project; other files may still be failing while the other agents work. You may run the single relevant test file to check your fix if you can.

Report back: the bug you found (line and what was wrong), the change you made, and the result of the relevant test run.
tasks.result:
## Outcome
Done: fixed the bug in `src/pricing.ts`, and `test/pricing.test.ts` passes 3/3.

## Changes
- `src/pricing.ts:7` (`applyDiscount`): the percentage was used as a fraction. `pct` is a whole percentage, so `1 - pct` gave `1 - 10 = -9` for a 10% discount. Changed to `Math.round(cents * (1 - pct / 100))`.

## Verification
`node --test test/pricing.test.ts`: pass 3, fail 0. Covers `subtotal`, `applyDiscount` (1000 at 10% gives 900, 1000 at 0% gives 1000), and `tax`.

## Open issues
None for this file. The `test/checkout.test.ts` and `test/inventory.test.ts` failures belong to the other agents' files and were not touched.

## Outcome
Done: the checkout bug is fixed and both tests in `test/checkout.test.ts` pass.

## Changes
- `src/checkout.ts:6`: when `reserve()` returned false, the loop did `continue`, so an out-of-stock SKU was silently skipped. It now throws `out of stock ${sku}`, as the doc comment on line 3 says.

## Verification
`node --test test/checkout.test.ts`: 2 pass, 0 fail. Before the fix, "checkout throws when out of stock" failed with "Missing expected exception".

## Open issues
None for checkout. The `reserve` semantics in `src/inventory.ts` (`have <= qty`) are outside my scope and I did not touch them. The "reserve can take the last units" test depends on that and belongs to the inventory agent.
